top_findings.title: All 7 MCP tools declare an empty inputSchema (no properties/required)
top_findings.evidence: src/soccer_mcp.erl:10-17 — every tool registered as inputSchema=>#{type=>"object"} with no properties/required; a strict MCP client cannot discover call args (caused factual_accuracy=0.0). Capability itself is implemented in filters/2 (soccer_mcp.erl:43-44) and tool_call/2 (soccer_mcp.erl:28-42).
top_findings.suggestion: Populate each tool's inputSchema.properties to match the args already parsed in filters/2.
